description: The paper applies the WHAT-IF hydro-economic model to evaluate water, agriculture and power investments under climate and socioeconomic uncertainty. It compares investment choices across linked sector markets. The provider is Publication authors / Copernicus Publications. Coverage: The application concerns the Zambezi River basin, shared by eight countries. It studies future investment scenarios, not reporting completed infrastructure outcomes. Access: The publisher provides the article and its application description openly. Model files and case data were not obtained. Licence and cost: The article is published under CC BY 4.0 and is free to read. Provider confirmation is required before reuse. Limitations: Economic losses and investment values are scenario results dependent on prices, climate and model assumptions. They were not independently reproduced. For simulation it provides a documented multi-sector investment-planning case. Related resources: The separate WHAT-IF repository is reviewed as P01131; this application is distinct from the reusable model.
